title: Debug impls for BearerAuth and BasicAuth redact credentials — do not derive Debug
description: BearerAuth and BasicAuth have hand-written Debug impls that emit [REDACTED] for the credential field, instead of the actual token or encoded password. A contributor might suggest removing these and using #[derive(Debug)] for simplicity. That would expose raw Bearer tokens and base64-encoded Basic credentials in logs, panic output, and test failure messages. These types explicitly carry secrets; redaction is the security-correct choice. The doc comment on AuthProvider also states implementations must not log the return value of auth_header(). Do not replace with derived Debug.
